blocks.text: Araras Eco Lodge: Canoeing and trekking

provenance.rationale: Extract the approved day's heading without its day-number prefix for this itinerary title.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, a photo safari and a canoe trip. In the afternoon, follow the Howler Monkey Trail to the 25-metre tower, then take a night drive in a special vehicle after dinner. See the excursion below for the full programme, including opportunities for fishing and watching otters.

The main itinerary includes a barbecue lunch and time to relax in a hammock. If Sentinela Camp is inaccessible because of the weather or road and terrain conditions, the canoe trip takes place on the Corixo River, followed by a return to the lodge for lunch. Clarinho and Corixo are included alternatives, rather than two guaranteed visits.

Your second night at Araras Eco Lodge.

Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
